_what_this_is: Season-long player touchdown over/under totals posted by actual sportsbooks for 2026. These override the team-budget allocation in vegas_anchor.py. The posted line is used as the point estimate with no adjustment applied -- a line IS the market's number, and shading it would reintroduce exactly the judgment layer this rebuild exists to remove.
_excluded_on_purpose: 'Odds to lead the NFL in rushing TDs' futures (Gibbs +500, Jacobs +900, Barkley +1600). These price the probability of a league-leading finish, not an expected touchdown total, and converting one into the other requires assuming a distribution shape. That is the assumption Jack asked to remove.
Kalshi prediction-market implied totals. No volume, ~40-cent spreads, and non-monotonic ladders.
